# Awesome MCP Servers

> Full Markdown catalog of 773 hand-curated Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. A shorter index lives at https://mcphq.org/llms.txt. The same records are published as JSON at https://mcphq.org/api/servers.json.

This file lists every server in the catalog. Descriptions are the catalog's one-sentence summaries, not the upstream README. `Official: yes` means the MCP project or the named provider backs the server. Repository, license, pricing, transport, auth, install, and verified date are included only when the catalog has them. Remote endpoints are included only when the catalog lists an SSE or streamable HTTP URL.

## Official and Reference Servers

Reference implementations, SDKs, and core protocol tooling from the MCP ecosystem.

Reference server exposing prompts, resources, and tools for protocol testing.

- URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/tree/main/src/everything

- Provider: Model Context Protocol
- Official: yes
- Tags: reference, testing, official
- Category: Official and Reference Servers
- Repository: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers
